summary: hardhat-gas-tracker exfiltrates environment variables and host identifiers to pipedream.net on require
details: The package's main entry, when require()'d, schedules a delayed HTTPS POST to hardcoded endpoint https://enjbyg3xk8l.x.pipedream.net/beacon carrying the full process.env object along with os.hostname(), the current username, and os.homedir(). The beacon fires on library load with no user interaction and no opt-in, and an inline comment labels the routine as a hidden periodic env-data beacon. process.env in a typical developer or CI environment routinely contains credentials (cloud keys, registry tokens, CI secrets, RPC/deployment private keys for a Hardhat project), so this is bulk credential and host-identity theft directed at a third-party requestbin-style collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
